crossRefs.note: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by…
Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among…
The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
“But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says Yahweh: “I will put my law…
being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living…

translations.web: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
translations.bsb: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
translations.kjv: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
translations.asv: I delight to do thy will, O my God; Yea, thy law is within my heart.
